bee-brood.name: Bee Brood 1.0
bee-brood.description: Production multimodal reasoning for image and video analysis, tool-enabled workflows, and multi-step planning at controlled cost.

bee-comb.name: Bee Comb 2.0
bee-comb.description: Stronger local/workstation AI for coding, architecture, security reasoning, larger RAG, and domain-specific workflows. The default workhorse for engineers and dev teams.

bee-hive.name: Bee Hive 1.0
bee-hive.description: Scalable Bee serving with quantum-reasoning routing and multi-base domain-adapter routing for shared knowledge workflows, document intelligence, and lower-cost cloud inference. Domain adapters activate per customer domain after evaluation.

bee-swarm.name: Bee Swarm 1.0
bee-swarm.description: Premium reasoning, multi-model cloud execution, large-document analysis, and high-value technical work. Includes the evolution engine and stronger eval gates by default.

bee-buzz.name: Bee Buzz 1.0
bee-buzz.description: Mid-tier production model for tool-using agents, multi-step workflows, and builder/integration work. Bigger context than Comb, deeper planning, faster than Hive on routine tasks.

bee-cell.name: Bee Cell 1.0
bee-cell.description: Fast hosted AI for chat, coding help, document question answering, image understanding, and lightweight technical reasoning.
